environment.description: Kubernetes pod with restricted SecurityContext. Pod spec includes securityContext.capabilities.drop containing CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. Container runs as non-root (runAsUser: 65534). Additionally, the node runs with kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=0 sysctl and the allocator is configured via LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/libhardened_malloc.so (GrapheneOS hardened_malloc fork) which implements slot-based allocation with randomized guard pages, canary validation on free(), and quarantine of freed allocations preventing reuse within 256 subsequent allocations. The container also has readOnlyRootFilesystem: true.
